name: Console commands
author: Brett
description: Tell Amber (any Claude session) to load a screen and your open console goes there: open any screen, dialog or settings tab (sub-tabs too) by id, title or a few words, run any registered action, go back or home, and list what the console has. The control@1 console domain over REST (/api/console), MCP tools console_open, console_dialog, console_settings, console_action, console_back, console_where, console_list and console_clients on the console's /mcp (and through axHub), and the CLI `axf console …`. Since Nov 4 2026 it is also the control surface broker for every app on the framework (AmberX, axHub web, Molly, every app the template builds, through the framework's control-surface library): apps_list, app_show, app_open, app_dialog, app_settings, app_action, app_back, app_where, app_list, app_clients; REST /api/console/apps and /api/console/app/*; CLI `axf apps`, `axf app <app> …`. Opening and moving only navigate; an action that changes data keeps its own permission, and one that deletes or resets needs a confirm token. Commands go to the app's client in front, else the one used last (or all of them, or one); an app with nobody open is woken on Brett's phone through AmberX.
